reason: I already know we do free bits for clients, and that's deliberate; it's how we've kept them for years. A report telling me to go and have uplift conversations is the exact thing I avoid, so I'd struggle to justify even the hour, let alone £99 a month.
objection: Finding the money isn't my problem, asking for it is. Scripts won't make me comfortable sending a long-standing client an uplift email, and I don't want a list that makes me feel guilty about goodwill I chose to give.
would_change_my_mind: If it was mostly about unbilled licences and plain mistakes, things I could quietly put right on the invoice without a conversation, and it actually made my month-end invoicing quicker.
